normalization: seed vaults and tokens (main and 2s-TTL profile) pinned in the file
Date header, log timestamps, peer ports

per-run OAuth entropy (client ids, codes, access/refresh tokens, token ids/hashes/prefixes, issued-at and ISO timestamps, vault byte snapshots) replaced by same-length deterministic placeholders; token/client registries recorded as their shape (counts, member names, revocations): those 26 rows carry a semantic_control, were asserted explicitly against the real Go values at capture, and are never compared byte-for-byte
the independent-entropy disjointness of Go and Rust values cannot be re-observed in replay; replay asserts Rust uniqueness only
